subject: TARGET CLAIM: cover visual composition ownership
body: AGENT_ID=display-rd. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. Subsystem: Fold7 cover visual composition/animation ownership across closing and closed->open. Dominant suspected limitation: current Fold7CoverRenderPolicy grants privileged Gen2 blanket cover ownership and PanelEngine then suppresses autonomous cover rendering, while the closing replacement DisplayMirrorHost presents a frozen/live right-pane crop but does not run the fold shader; opening uses a separate PanelEngine one-shot path with service-global start state. This splits content ownership from effect behavior implicitly and can yield a visible cover with no fold animation. Investigation boundary: renderer/effect ownership, visual-intent lifecycle, engine/host replacement/remap, reversal and exact-cycle visual lease. Preserve existing cover lease authority, readiness, frame provenance, presentation identity, physical-panel rules, thresholds, and early inner wake unless direct conflict is proven. Overlap scan: no active Agent Bus workstream beyond primary Gen3 baseline. Repository prior work on cover lease/readiness/frame provenance/presentation was found and will be treated as adjacent solved layers, not duplicated.
